policies.n: Ordinary Macao SAR passports only. The arrival-visa concession is limited to Osvaldo Vieira International Airport, Bissau. It does not establish arrival issuance at land or sea borders, or guarantee issuance or admission. Other visa channels are not determined by this record.

Singapore ordinary-passport visitors. Passport must have at least six months validity on expected departure. Singapore MFA describes the arrival-visa facility but gives no port-specific implementation details; confirm current issuance arrangements before travel.

A visa is required for Dutch passports; passport must remain valid for at least six months on arrival. The source directs travellers to the Guinea-Bissau embassy in Brussels. Stay and electronic/arrival eligibility are not established.
Belgian nationals require a visa. The source identifies the Guinea-Bissau missions in Brussels and Dakar; it does not establish permitted stay or rule out electronic or arrival channels.
Moldovan ordinary passports require a visa. The current MFA table identifies diplomatic missions; stay and other issuance methods are unspecified, not declared unavailable.
Moldovan ordinary-passport short visitors are visa-exempt according to Moldova MFA. No permitted stay is specified in the ordinary-passport row.

For Mongolian ordinary passports, the MFA explicitly requires visas for destinations outside its exemption schedule, including Guinea-Bissau. Issuance method and permitted stay are not established; electronic issuance is not ruled out.

India MEA describes a visa-on-arrival facility and recommends obtaining advance Interior Ministry entry authorization requested by the host or employer. Its 90-day figure is visa validity; the permitted stay and port-specific implementation are not established. Confirm authorization and issuance arrangements before travel.

Taiwan nationals are instructed to obtain a visa at a Guinea-Bissau mission before travel. Passport validity of at least six months, departure ticket and yellow-fever certificate are listed. Stay and electronic eligibility are not established.

Mali’s public government lookup explicitly requires a visa for an ordinary passport with residence in the passport country. The result establishes the requirement only: permitted stay, electronic or arrival issuance, and any additional clearance remain unconfirmed. It is not a guarantee of tourist issuance or admission and does not mean eVisa is unavailable.

The Mali government lookup explicitly requires a visa for the Palestine nationality option, ordinary passport, and residence in Palestine. This establishes a permission requirement only. Acceptance of a particular Palestinian issuing authority or document variant, the competent issuance channel and stay still require confirmation; routine tourist issuance or admission is not established.
policies.label: Visa required; document handling unconfirmed

policies.n: The Mali government lookup exempts these ordinary-passport nationals and instructs them to present identity documents or passports currently valid in their own country. The recorded checks use residence in the passport country. No tourist stay length or unrestricted residence/work right is specified.
Ordinary Macao SAR passports: visa exemption for up to 90 days. This is current DSI confirmation of the concession, with a link to the 2004 agreement, not a newly enacted 2026 policy.

Taiwan nationals must obtain a visa before travel and carry a yellow-fever vaccination certificate. BOCA identifies consular submission by appointment and requires checking residence-based mission jurisdiction. Stay and electronic eligibility are unspecified.

Visa required for ordinary-passport tourism without a qualifying supporting document. Article 17 permits conditional visa-free entry with a valid multiple-entry visa or residence permit issued by a Schengen state, EU member state or the United States: no more than 30 uninterrupted days, within 90 days in any 180-day period and within document validity. No such document is assumed. Visa issuance channel and stay remain unconfirmed; eVisa is not declared unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; foreign-document exemption conditional

policies.n: Taiwan passport holders may visit for tourism without a visa for 30 days. Passport must be valid more than six months from entry and a return/onward reservation is required. The ArriveAntigua electronic declaration is optional; a paper arrival card remains available.

Ordinary Macao SAR passports are eligible for Cameroon’s electronic visa process. Obtain the online authorization before travel and complete the applicable biometric/visa-printing formalities under the Cameroon procedure. Permitted tourist stay is not specified.

Taiwan nationals travelling for short tourism may use Cameroon’s official electronic visa process. Obtain authorization before travel and complete the applicable biometric/visa-printing formalities. BOCA advises confirming current entry requirements with a Cameroon mission; permitted stay is unspecified.

Visa required. Taiwan BOCA confirms continued conditional arrival-visa issuance: travellers from countries without a Bangladesh embassy must justify the necessity of travel, and issuance remains discretionary. The separately documented investment/business invitation procedure is not assumed for tourism. Obtain confirmation of the appropriate visa channel before travel; no tourist stay or guaranteed arrival eligibility is established.
policies.label: Visa required; arrival issuance conditional

policies.n: Sri Lanka’s current DI&E guidance requires prior entry permission for ordinary foreign visitors. For these passports, the appropriate restricted-nationality approval or referral channel is not established; ordinary direct-online ETA and arrival issuance are not certified. Confirm the necessary approval with DI&E before travel. No permitted stay is assigned, and electronic issuance is not declared unavailable.
policies.label: Prior permission required; channel unconfirmed

policies.n: Denmark explicitly requires a visa for Somali nationals. An ordinary Somali passport must not be assumed to satisfy the separate travel-document recognition rules. The acceptable original or substitute document, any limited-territorial authorization, transit permissions and a practical tourist issuance path remain unconfirmed. This records the visa obligation only, not routine issuance, admission or a nationality-wide entry ban.
policies.label: Visa required; document authorization unresolved

policies.n: Switzerland explicitly requires a visa for Somali nationals and independently requires a recognized travel document. An ordinary Somali passport must not be assumed sufficient. A competent-authority decision on the acceptable original or substitute document, territorial permission and transit routing is still needed. Tourist issuance channel and stay are not established; this is not routine admission clearance or a nationality-wide ban.
policies.label: Visa required; document authorization unresolved

policies.n: Chile’s consular nationality table explicitly lists Kosovo as visa-required and notes that Chile does not recognize Kosovo as a subject of international law. This does not establish rejection of every Kosovo document or a nationality-wide entry ban. Accepted original/substitute travel-document treatment and a practical tourist visa issuance route remain unconfirmed; no routine issuance or stay is promised.
policies.label: Visa required; document handling unconfirmed
